explanation: h(n) is the minimum number of distinct distances over n-point sets in ℝ² in general position (no three collinear, no four concyclic), matching erdosproblems.com/98. Erdős–Füredi–Pach (EFPR93) proved h(n) < n·exp(c√(log n)). The statement gives c > 0 with this bound for all large n. Faithful.
